source_title: Save $102 on Lenovo’s big-screen Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 tablet
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
Lenovo’s Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 is built for people who want a big Android tablet for movies, notes, and getting work done, and there’s a solid deal on it right now on Amazon. This model stands out with a 13-inch 3.5K IPS touchscreen and a fast 144Hz refresh rate, giving you a large, sharp display that’s well suited for both entertainment and day-to-day tasks.
Inside, the tablet packs a Qualcomm Snapdragon 8s Gen 4 chip with Adreno 825 graphics, plus 8GB of RAM and 128GB of storage. That setup gives it upper-midrange to near-premium performance, which is a good fit for streaming, note-taking, and light creative work. The screen is one of the main highlights here, with a 3504 x 2190 resolution, strong color coverage, and brightness that works well for both watching content and staying productive.
It also comes bundled with the Lenovo Tab Pen Plus and a folio case, making it ready for handwriting, sketching, school, or office use right out of the box. Lenovo also positions the tablet as a strong value option for buyers who want a large-screen experience without paying the much higher prices often associated with top-end flagship tablets.
As for the deal, the Lenovo Idea Tab Pro Gen 2 is down to $447.36 on Amazon from its $549.99 recommended retail price. That’s a 19% discount off the RRP, which cuts $102 off the usual price and makes now a good time to pick one up.
